Thanks for the heads up, Marissa. Quick answers: 

1) NDA owner: Contracts team (cc'ing Laura) will take the first pass on mutual NDAs. Laura will coordinate with our outside counsel for any novel clauses.

2) Sequencing: Standard approach = NDA first (sign), then DPA (if PHI/PII in scope) and MSA for commercial terms. In cases where the customer is large and requests faster procurement, we can run a parallel track (NDA + MSA simultaneously) but only if Legal has the full MSA redlines in-hand - otherwise it's more friction. For Acme Health, given PHI sensitivity, recommend NDA -> DPA -> MSA sequencing.

3) Turn times (our internal SLAs we can communicate):
   - NDA: initial review within 1-3 business days for standard mutual NDAs; 5-7 if there are specific carve-outs or IP clauses.
   - DPA: privacy team typically 3-7 business days depending on whether templates suffice.
   - MSA: expect 7-14 business days for initial redline review; longer if there are substantive commercial items.

If Procurement wants faster, we can prioritize but will need a clear decision owner and a signed NDA to exchange detailed security appendices.

Action items:
- Laura: please confirm you can own the NDA review and loop outside counsel if needed.
- Marissa: once Sofia's DocuSign link arrives, please forward the signed stub so Contracts can start review.
- Alex: keep the technical appendix ready so we can attach to the DPA/MSA.
